description: Source code for an API parser class that reads markdown documentation files, extracts class/method/parameter info, and constructs a documentation model.

classes.name: ApiParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing markdown API documentation files into a structured documentation model.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads markdown files from a directory, and builds class/method/parameter structures.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a class definition node from markdown into a docs.Class object.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses a class member (method, event, property) node from markdown.

methods.name: parseArgument
methods.description: Parses method argument or option nodes from markdown.

methods.name: parseProperty
methods.description: Parses a property or parameter node from markdown.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Parses type information from markdown list items.

methods.name: parseVariable
methods.description: Parses variable, type, return, or argument info from a line of markdown.

methods.name: applyTemplates
methods.description: Applies markdown templates to the documentation body.

methods.name: extractComments
methods.description: Extracts comment nodes from a documentation section.

methods.name: parseApi
methods.description: Entry point function to parse API documentation from a directory.

methods.name: extractMetainfo
methods.description: Extracts metadata like since, deprecated, hidden, etc., from a documentation node.

methods.name: extractLangs
methods.description: Extracts language-specific info from documentation nodes.

methods.name: extractSince
methods.description: Extracts 'since' version info from documentation nodes.

methods.name: extractHidden
methods.description: Checks if a documentation node is marked as hidden.

methods.name: extractAttribute
methods.description: Extracts specific attribute values from documentation nodes.

methods.name: childrenWithoutProperties
methods.description: Filters out property-related children from documentation nodes.

methods.name: isTypeOverride
methods.description: Determines if a member's type override is valid.

methods.name: checkNoDuplicateParamEntries
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate parameter entries in the documentation.
